gloss: original copy; official document; authenticated text

definitions.gloss: original copy; official document; authenticated text
definitions.explanation: The authoritative, official version of a document or text, as opposed to copies or drafts. Used in legal, administrative, and scholarly contexts for documents that carry legal or official weight.

examples.japanese: {契約書|けいやくしょ}の{正本|せいほん}を{保管|ほかん}する。
examples.english: To keep the original copy of the contract.

examples.japanese: {判決|はんけつ}の{正本|せいほん}が{裁判所|さいばんしょ}から{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: The official copy of the verdict arrived from the court.

examples.japanese: この{文書|ぶんしょ}はコピーではなく{正本|せいほん}であることを{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please confirm that this document is the original, not a copy.

notes:
Composed of {正|せい} (correct, authentic) and {本|ほん} (book, document). In legal contexts, the {正本|せいほん} is a certified copy issued by a court that has the same effect as the original. Distinct from an ordinary copy ({写|うつ}し or コピー).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正本|せいほん}を{交付|こうふ}する: to issue an official copy
- {正本|せいほん}を{保管|ほかん}する: to store the original
- {判決|はんけつ}{正本|せいほん}: certified copy of a judgment
- {契約|けいやく}{正本|せいほん}: original contract document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {原本|げんぽん}: original — the very first version of a document from which copies are made
- {副本|ふくほん}: duplicate, secondary copy — an official copy made alongside the original
- {謄本|とうほん}: certified copy — a full copy of an official register, such as a family register ({戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん})
